summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Banco de Chile reporting a local-market bond placement, not a special situation. The bank placed Serie FG senior dematerialized bearer bonds for CLF 400,000 (in Unidades de Fomento) maturing November 1, 2030, at an average rate of 2.82%. The disclosure fulfills Chilean Material Information requirements under Articles 9 and 10 of Law 18,045. No terms such as price per share, premium, or board recommendation appear. As a standard debt issuance without equity or structural change, this filing does not trigger event-driven classification.
